notes.text: The upper block gives the source’s definition of beta: a group of compatible pairs (g, bar g), pi = Aut(tilde Pi/Pi), a projection to G and an object set Ob tilde Pi with an evident action. The arrow/shaft diagram is transcribed as ink, without a proof of exactness. The separate phrase Variantes profinies… follows.

Circled paragraph 8 recalls an extension and a nonempty set on which pi acts freely, then places a double-headed correspondence next to the groupoid tuple. It proposes interpreting data called a triple. The small inserted chi makes the written tuple contain four entries; the word triple is retained without correction.

The source asks whether T is isomorphic to the hatted integer group, with an explicit question mark. It adds chi : G to Aut(T), and a crowded comparison involving hatted Z-star and canon.?. The tall curved stroke after Z-star is now explicitly represented as an unsure closing-parenthesis/question-like sign; the whole parenthesis remains unsure. No canonical identification is asserted by this review.

A separate chi-colon is visibly interlinear above où. It is retained at that position independently of the complete chi map below; the source provides no caret settling its intended grammatical attachment. Phi maps the round-labelled set to Hom_gr(T, pi). The last line ends mid-parenthesis at opérant; no completion is supplied.

The two final tuple components are low waves, explicitly sim/compressed-a. The round set label remains tau/calligraphic T. The pair-definition and upper-extension capitals favour cursive E through two open bowls, but the shared E/Sigma convention remains provisional pending cross-page comparison. All unresolved alphabet-only choices are non-consequential.

The bottom-left 18 is in pencil and is assigned to an unnamed hand. H’s long editorial notation note is not source text. Small detached pen taps and paper marks without a legible textual form are not promoted to superscripts, punctuation, or cancelled words.

raw_difference_disposition: All 43 packet difference entries were inspected against the original once, each native half, and one crop for each unresolved locus. All page text, signs, indices, underlining, insertions, cancellation, diagrams and footer were checked, including C/H agreements. Markup-only scan labels, tikzcd scaffolding, math spacing, Ob thinspace parsed as a comma, mapsto extraction artifacts, semicolon math-spacing artifacts, and ellipsis encoding differences are excluded. H’s editorial note is excluded as editorial text. Plain versus calligraphic G and bold versus blackboard Z are rendering choices; reported alphabet-only Z and T/tau choices carry medium confidence and consequential false. The only original packet MARK is M0698; new doubts are confined to remaining_doubts. The pi-identity crop confirms the tilde and slash without generating a change row. The first half2 display attempt did not return a viewable image because output was truncated; the subsequent successful display was the actual half2 inspection.

main_adjudication.summary: Original and all ten reader-C crops inspected, followed by nine main crops for every remaining page-only change. Accepted with explicit preservation of the extra curved sign after Z-star. The chi-map endpoint was checked against the same crop: a small raised angular head is present, so the shared arrow reading is retained. No bare-connector change is made there.
